# v1.2.19 — Smarter recommendations + Rankings

## What changed

- **A real recommendation engine.** The "Recommended for You" shelf used to just
  count the genres of your last few reads. It now builds a weighted interest
  profile from everything you do — what you read, how deep you read, how
  recently, and what you bookmark — then scores every candidate title against it.
  Recommendations span **manhwa, manga, manhua, novels, classics and print
  books**, not just one genre.
- **More shelves.** Instead of a single row you now get several, each explained:
  *Recommended for You*, *Because you read …*, *More {your favorite genre}*, and
  a *For Manhwa/Novel Readers* shelf. Each card can carry a small "why" chip
  (e.g. "More Action", "Because you read Solo Leveling").
- **Rankings, right on the Home screen.** A new **Rankings** section ranks the
  whole catalogue and lets you pick the criterion yourself: Most Popular,
  Trending Now, Top Rated, Most Read, Longest, Shortest, Newest, Recently
  Updated, Best Matches, Most Downloaded, A–Z, and Completed Only. Filter by
  content type (Manhwa, Manga, Manhua, Novels, Classics, Print) and, for
  "Most Read", switch between your own activity and a global proxy.
- **Tell us what you don't want.** Every rankings card has a thumbs-down button.
  It is remembered locally and quietly pushes similar titles down in your
  recommendations.
- **Honest numbers.** Most sources do not publish real view or rating counts, so
  ranking metrics are clearly labelled as estimates — never invented precision.

## Under the hood

- New pure module `server/recommendation-engine.js` (profile, scoring, ranking,
  explanations) with its own unit tests.
- New endpoints: `GET /api/recommend`, `GET /api/rankings`,
  `GET /api/rankings/criteria`, and `POST/GET /api/user/signals`.
- New derived cache table `title_signals` (rebuilt from your bookmarks, history
  and read log) plus an optional `user_signals` table for thumbs up/down. Both
  are created automatically and backfilled on first launch.
- **Richer rankings data.** Chapter counts and series status only live on each
  title's detail page, so metadata-based rankings (Longest, Shortest, Top Rated,
  Completed) now hydrate those fields once and store them in a new `title_meta`
  cache. Results get sharper after the first launch and stay correct offline.
- **Rankings paginate.** The list loads 24 at a time and keeps absolute ranks
  (page 2 starts at #25) as you scroll.
- **Fixed a caching bug** that stopped listing-style responses (rankings,
  recommendations) from ever being cached, forcing every visit to re-fetch from
  providers. Repeat loads are now instant.
- Tests: `tests/recommendation-engine.test.js`, `tests/rankings-view.test.js`,
  `tests/title-signals.test.js`.
